_note: Program list researched from Aimsir's public website and Instagram on 2026-10-21; confirmed correct by Sean Smith on 2026-10-22. No participant counts or budgets are included because none were verifiable.

programs.name: First Flight Forward
programs.summary: Fully funds students to experience aviation firsthand, from ground school through a first discovery flight, delivered with Helix Aviation Academy and Gulf Coast Aviation in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. Launch announcement stated 10 students fully funded.

programs.name: Joyce Bannister Memorial Aviation Scholarship
programs.summary: $10,000 award toward private through commercial pilot certificate or rating. Applicant must be 16+, hold a Student Pilot Certificate, and be a US citizen/permanent resident or able to train in the US; preference to applicants in or from the Bahamas. 5th annual cycle ran Jan 2-31, 2026 with announcement Feb 14; funds released on verified acceptance to an approved program with 12 months to use.

programs.name: Aviation & STEM Scholarships
programs.summary: Targeted financial support for training milestones such as ground school, medical exams, checkrides and equipment, plus STEM learning experiences.
programs.geography: United States and developing countries (per mission)

programs.name: Mentorship & Pathways
programs.summary: Pairs students with aviation and STEM professionals who help translate 'I want to fly' into a plan: prerequisites, timelines, safety culture and options across aviation careers from pilot to engineer.

programs.name: Aviation STEM Education & Community Outreach
programs.summary: Hands-on workshops (flight simulators, maintenance demos, drone safety, coding, aerodynamics), school visits and career events that show aviation as an industry, not just a job. Examples posted: school visit at North Lauderdale Elementary (FL), Helix Aviation Academy talk, October 3 event at the National Museum of the United States Air Force (Dayton, OH).
programs.audience: Elementary through high-school students; educators and families
